name: Emo Shaonü
source:
"Devil Girl" is a game that combines love building with the Cthulhu weird style. One day, you wake up and find a beautiful girl with whom you can live happily and do all kinds of H things or explore the truths of the world……..

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1466180/Devil_Girl/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《恶魔女孩》是一款将恋爱养成与克苏鲁怪异风格相结合的游戏。有一天，你醒来发现一个美丽的女孩，你可以和她幸福地生活，做各种H事或探索世界的真相……

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1466180/Devil_Girl/]Steam[/url]]
